title: Lightning
author: Claude
blurb: A storm at night, made of blocks. Game-Maker has no flash, so every block that shows sky has a twin drawn on a lighter sky, and each turns into its twin for a moment and back, all on the same clock: the whole sky flashes at once. The bolt is five blocks that look like sky until then. A block can't make a sound, so the thunder is in the song, a beat after each flash. Level 1 is a field in the storm; in level 2 the stones over a dark ditch light up with the sky. The flash is kept gentle: one every 7 seconds, short and gray-blue. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the sky's blocks.

box.tagline: A flash, a bolt, and the thunder after.
